headline: Evernorth Writes Down Pre-Listing XRP Holdings by 60%
summary: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60% due to an accounting policy requiring price declines to be recorded without reversal upon recovery.
why: Evernorth is a crypto investment company supported by Ripple. Impairment rules for digital assets affect corporate balance sheet valuations during market downturns.

impacts.name: XRP
impacts.why: Evernorth wrote down its pre-listing holdings of XRP by 60%.
